title: PureShield
description: A clean and minimal Lower Shield texture pack that improves visibility while maintaining Minecraft’s classic vanilla experience.
body:
PureShield is a modern Lower Shield texture pack designed to enhance visibility without compromising the original Minecraft aesthetic. By lowering the shield position on the screen, the pack allows players to maintain a clearer view of their surroundings during combat, exploration, and building.

Built with a clean and minimal design, PureShield ensures that the interface remains smooth and distraction-free while staying true to the vanilla style. This subtle yet effective adjustment makes gameplay feel more fluid, especially in fast-paced PvP situations and precise movements like bridging.

Ideal for both competitive and casual players, PureShield delivers a balanced combination of functionality and style—allowing you to stay protected without blocking your view. 🛡️✨
